Meta.title: {brand}: robots made for tinkering
Meta.description: Named robots for children, teenagers, and competition teams: Ciko, Momo, and Garu. Each comes with a free online learning path, a browser simulator, upgrade packs, and arenas. We sell single units, school bulk orders, and OEM.

hero.title: Robots made for tinkering.
hero.body: Every robot has a name, a number, and its own learning path. Pick by age and goal: starting from zero, training for a contest, or digging deeper.
hero.dropBody: The next R&D robot. Its name and shape are still under wraps.

ages.title: Which robot fits?
ages.intro: Each robot stands at the age it is designed to start from. The ages are a guide, not a rule.

comesWith.title: Not just owning a robot, but understanding it
comesWith.intro: Every Taksu robot comes with a way to understand it, free and online. No classes: follow it at home, at your own pace.

path.title: A learning path for each robot
path.body: Step by step from unboxing to contest-ready, with videos and guides.

sim.title: A simulator in the browser
sim.body: Build programs with blocks and test them in a virtual arena before the robot arrives.

code.title: Code you can take with you
code.body: Every block program has an Arduino C++ version. When you are ready, carry on in the Arduino IDE.

comesWith.imageAlt: The Taksu simulator: program blocks on the left, Ciko following a line in the arena on the right
comesWith.caption: Ciko’s Follow the line mission, step 9 on its learning path.

addOns.title: Add abilities
addOns.intro: Upgrade packs add sensors and new projects to the robot you have. Arenas use the same tracks as the simulator.

buy.title: How to buy
buy.intro: One or many, through whichever channel suits you.

direct.title: Order directly
direct.body: Add to the cart, then send the order over WhatsApp or email. We reply with the total, shipping, and how to pay.

market.title: Marketplaces
market.body: Buy from our store on a marketplace, with the usual payment and tracking.
market.soon: Our Tokopedia and Shopee stores are on the way. Until then, order directly through the cart.

bulk.title: Buy in bulk

bulk.title: Schools, courses, and competition teams

oem.title: OEM: our robots, your brand
oem.body: Use Taksu robots with your name, logo, and packaging, or have us design a new one.

Accessories.title: Accessories and upgrades
Accessories.intro: Upgrade packs add sensors and new projects to the robot you already have. Arenas use the same tracks as the simulator. The rest keeps robots running and classrooms ready.

kinds.upgrade: Add sensors, a gripper, or a camera to your robot, with new projects and missions.
kinds.arena: Printed tracks that match the simulator’s arenas, so a program that passes on screen can go straight to the floor.
kinds.aksesori: Spare batteries and parts for simple repairs at home.
kinds.sekolah: For classes and courses: charge many robots at once, store them tidily, and teach with the instructor kit.

Learn.title: Understand your robot, one step at a time
Learn.meta: A free learning path for every Taksu robot: short videos, guides, and simulator missions you can follow at home.
Learn.intro: Not a class and not a course. Every Taksu robot has a free learning path: short videos, guides, and simulator missions you can follow at home, at your own pace.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: One idea in a sentence or two, often with a short video.

try.title: Try
try.body: Build a block program, then test it in the simulator arena until it passes.

run.title: Run
run.body: Upload the same program to the robot and watch it on the floor.

Learn.soon: The full path arrives with the robot.

sim.title: No robot yet? Start in the simulator
sim.body: The simulator runs in the browser, free, with no account. Its missions are the steps on the learning paths, so nothing is wasted when the robot arrives.
sim.imageAlt: The Taksu simulator: program blocks on the left, the arena with Ciko on the right

guides.title: Guides
guides.intro: Step-by-step instructions for unboxing, building, charging, and moving programs from the simulator to the robot.

Learn.notService: Taksu sells robots, not courses. These learning paths come with every robot and are free for anyone.

DropPage.title: Drops: R&D robots, one at a time
DropPage.intro: Besides the main robots, we keep testing new ideas on our R&D bench. The ones that pass are released as Drops: the next number in the Taksu series, made in limited batches.

series.title: The Taksu series
series.intro: Main robots and Drops share one run of numbers. The next number always goes to the next release.
series.open: Number {n} waits for the release after that
